title: International Pantry Staples for Pregnancy Nutrition
excerpt: Oats, Greek yogurt, lentils, low-mercury salmon, eggs, leafy greens, and citrus — practical ways to build balanced plates.
content:
## Introduction
When pregnant, a healthy diet plays a crucial role in ensuring the well-being of both mother and baby. International pantry staples can provide a diverse range of nutritious options for expectant mothers. In this article, we will explore the best international pantry staples for pregnancy nutrition and how to incorporate them into daily meals.

## International Pantry Staples for Pregnancy Nutrition
The following international pantry staples are considered beneficial for pregnant women:
- Oats: rich in fiber, supporting digestive health and reducing the risk of constipation.
- Greek yogurt: rich in calcium, protein, and probiotics, supporting bone health and immune function.
- Lentils: rich in iron, protein, and fiber, supporting blood production and reducing the risk of anemia.
- Low-mercury salmon: rich in omega-3 fatty acids, supporting brain and heart health.
- Eggs: rich in protein, vitamins, and minerals, supporting overall health and development.
- Leafy greens and citrus: rich in vitamin C, supporting immune function and reducing the risk of illness.

## Incorporating International Pantry Staples into Meals
To incorporate these international pantry staples into meals, pregnant women can consider the following suggestions:
- Breakfast: oats with Greek yogurt and fruit.
- Lunch: salad with lentils, leafy greens, and low-mercury salmon.
- Dinner: scrambled eggs with leafy greens and citrus.
- Additionally, pregnant women can consult our [meal planner](/planner) for a personalized and varied meal plan.

## Food Safety During Pregnancy
Food safety is a critical concern during pregnancy. Pregnant women should avoid:
- Raw or undercooked foods.
- Foods high in mercury.
- Foods containing listeria.
- To ensure food safety, pregnant women can consult our [prenatal nutrition](/blog/prenatal-nutrition) and [pregnancy recipes](/blog/pregnancy-recipes) sections.

## Conclusion
International pantry staples can provide a diverse range of nutritious options for pregnant women. However, it is essential to prioritize food safety and incorporate these staples into meals in a balanced and varied way. For a personalized and varied meal plan, pregnant women can consult our [premium](/premium) and [blog](/blog) sections.
